feedback_text: The AI-drafted resolution notes save our on-call engineers so much time -- we used to skip writing them entirely.
Sometimes the auto-drafted note misses the actual root cause and just repeats the alert text. We still have to rewrite half of it.
Would trust the AI-drafted note more if it flagged which parts were inferred vs pulled directly from logs.
Love that resolution notes get pre-filled now. Our SLA compliance on documentation went way up this month.
Can the draft include links to the specific traces it used? Right now it's just prose, hard to verify.
We're only half-rolled-out on this and already the team that has it stopped complaining about postmortem busywork.
The other half of our team without the AI drafting is asking when they get it too.
Competitor X's tool apparently does this already and their reps are using it as a selling point against us.
We heard about the AI resolution-notes feature from another customer at a conference -- when is it coming to us?
Writing resolution notes by hand is the #1 complaint from our on-call rotation. Anything that automates it is a win.
Not using the platform's incident workflow much yet, so can't comment on the AI notes specifically.
Our team is small -- anything that cuts manual documentation steps matters a lot to us.
